# Psalm 32 — Disagreement Log

## 32:2 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Blessed-is the-man to-whom YHWH does-not impute iniquity, and-in-whose spirit there-is-no deceit.
- **LOGOS:** Blessed is the man against whom the LORD counts no iniquity, and in whose spirit there is no deceit.
- **PNEUMA:** What joy for those whose record the LORD has cleared of guilt, whose lives are lived in complete honesty!

- **LOGOS:** I acknowledged my sin to You, and I did not cover my iniquity; I said, 'I will confess my transgressions to the LORD,' and You forgave the iniquity of my sin. Selah.
- **PNEUMA:** Finally, I confessed all my sins to You and stopped trying to hide my guilt. I said to myself, 'I will confess my rebellion to the LORD.' And You forgave me! All my guilt is gone. Pause and reflect.
